rules: canonical state is user-scoped and server-authoritative
persisted draft/autosave/revision state is shared across clients
stale client mutations are rejected deterministically with stale_canonical_state
client refreshes canonical state before retrying a stale mutation
server-owned profile/preferences/permissions are included in canonical state
all client SDK mutation requests carry the current canonical state hash and client identity
mobile Story Studio autosave persists remotely after the debounce interval when authenticated
cross-platform acceptance must exercise mutation from each client and read-back from all other clients
state-sync authenticated mutations without a canonical state hash are rejected before mutation
all first-party client SDK mutation paths refresh canonical state and retry once on stale_canonical_state
local client persistence cannot be used as an authoritative account, social, monetization, story, or reader source
